description: Open-source Python library for quantum computing. Build quantum algorithms once, run them on any simulator or quantum computer.
rules: Choose the backend with the provider= argument of Circuit; the algorithm code does not change.
Backends other than the built-in numpy simulator need their pip extra, e.g. pip install "eigenkit[qiskit]".
CudaQuantumBackend and QiskitRuntimeBackend are opt-in: register them with eigenkit.register() before using their provider name.
On paid hardware, gradients are opt-in (enable_gradients=True in the device config); call dry_run_info() before submitting jobs.
Use interface="torch" to get a torch.nn.Module; the ready-made models follow scikit-learn's fit/predict.
Import the names in eigenkit.__all__ from eigenkit itself (from eigenkit import Circuit), and domain names from their package (eigenkit.optimization, eigenkit.chemistry).
